title: The Boy from the Poldi Chimneys

paragraphs.text: I was born in Kladno in 1946 and grew up in a street just by the Poldi steelworks. My dad František worked at the furnace, and when he went off to his shift you could hear his boots all down the street.
My mum Anna baked buns with plum jam. "Oh, that smell, it drifted all the way out to the yard," I still say today.
My sister Věrka and I were always squabbling at home, but when things got tough, we stuck together.
I spent most of my time with Pepa Dvořák, who lived next door and was two years younger than me. We played football on the patch until it got dark.

openQuestions: How did running off to the fair in Prague with Pepa end?
